start.content: Good day! The market moves faster than news. People are saying strange things. What draws you to my stall?

choices.text: I'm looking for information about the Galilean.
Have you seen any unusual activity in the courts?

galilean_rumors.content: People are saying He healed a blind man at Bethesda. Others say He raised someone from the dead in Bethany. The Pharisees are trying to keep it quiet, but you can't stop a story like that from spreading.

court_rumors.content: The Temple courts have been a whirlwind for three days running. Questions, answers, more questions — and the Galilean keeps trapping them with His words.

priest_response.content: The chief priests and Pharisees met in emergency session after Lazarus. They're planning something. I don't know what, but when the Sanhedrin starts meeting before dawn, it's never good for anyone.

closing.content: Keep your eyes open. The coin-changers' guild has informants everywhere — and three days ago I saw one of them slipping into the High Priest's courtyard with a leather pouch full of silver.
